STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits on a white square-ish plate with a raised rim band and a flat centre, no inner wall visible. Flat plate (square).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type cue: square plates are typically 20-30 cm; this looks like a medium dinner plate, so about 25 cm.
b) Reference cue: the fork at top left is only partly visible, so it is not reliable. The plate spans roughly the full frame height (about 480 px for the plate width), and the green beans are about 10-12 cm long, so the plate width is roughly 2.5 beans-lengths... using the green beans (~10 cm) across the plate yields about 2.5 beans, which is too few to be reliable. Relying on the type cue and the framing, I take width ≈ 25 cm.
Final width: 25 cm, so area = 625 cm².

STEP 3 - Food items (estimated footprints and thicknesses):
- Fish fillet (white flaky fish, centre-right): about 12% of plate = 75 cm². Thickness ~2 cm (mound/flake layer, half peak). Volume ≈ 75 × 1.5 = 113 ml × 1.0 = about 110 g.
- Chicken/white fish cover (near the fish, lower right, flaky with sauce): included above.
- Cooked spinach (dark leaves under fish and lower right): about 10% = 63 cm² × 1.0 cm = 63 ml × 0.6 = about 40 g.
- Green beans (cooked, left-centre): about 15% = 94 cm² × 1.0 cm = 94 ml × 0.6 = about 55 g.
- Raw spinach/chard leaves (upper left, with red stems): about 20% = 125 cm² × 3 cm × 0.15 but loose leaves compress; use 2.5 cm: 312 ml × 0.15 = about 45 g.
- Flatbread/tortilla (upper right, golden): about 10% = 63 cm² × 0.3 cm = 19 ml × 0.3 (bread) ≈ 6 g, but a thin wrap-type piece of ~40 g is more realistic, so use 40 g.
- Roasted vegetables on flatbread (red pepper, courgette): about 5% = 31 cm² × 1.0 cm = 31 ml × 0.6 = about 20 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: a few sauce or oil traces; no significant hidden base layer. Total ≈ 110 + 40 + 55 + 45 + 40 + 20 = 310 g.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served):
- Fish (cooked white fish, with some oil/sauce): ~120 kcal/100 g.
- Cooked spinach: ~25 kcal/100 g.
- Green beans, cooked: ~35 kcal/100 g.
- Raw leafy greens: ~23 kcal/100 g.
- Flatbread/wrap: ~290 kcal/100 g.
- Roasted pepper and courgette: ~50 kcal/100 g.

Total ≈ 110×1.2 + 40×0.25 + 55×0.35 + 45×0.23 + 40×2.9 + 20×0.5 ≈ 132 + 10 + 19 + 10 + 116 + 10 ≈ 297 kcal.
